claims.claim_text: The uncommon indexed Eden Brenes name is probably the civilian assistant documented with the OSS representative at Tangier in 1944-1945.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Assistant to the Office of Strategic Services Representative at Tangier from September 1944 to August 1945
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A photographed Truman-signed citation names Eden Brenes and dates an OSS representative assignment at Tangier from September 1944 through August 1945.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact uncommon name and OSS context align, but the reviewed citation supplies no Box 78 pointer or private identifier; the match remains probable.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source documents OSS service in 1944-1945 but does not establish a pre-OSS employer or the recruitment pathway.
claims.match_notes: The citation is qualified identity evidence only. It is not converted into a pre-OSS affiliation claim.
